text:
The primary bottleneck in the current operational process is the reliance on paper-based systems for expense reporting and approval. This manual approach creates a significant inefficiency loop: physical documents must be transported, manually reviewed, and entered into systems, which directly causes the backlog of unprocessed claims. This delay in processing leads to delayed reimbursements, resulting in employee dissatisfaction. Furthermore, the manual nature of the workflow introduces a high risk of human error during data entry, which can lead to financial inaccuracies and additional time spent on corrections.

To improve efficiency, the finance department should transition to a digital expense management system. Implementing an automated platform would allow employees to submit claims electronically, reduce manual data entry errors, and streamline the approval workflow through digital routing. This change would eliminate the physical backlog, accelerate reimbursement times, and improve overall accuracy and employee satisfaction.
